items.title: 11.2.4 Physical properties of alkanes (alkanes ki physical properties) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.2.4, printed page 251.

items: Chaar carbon atoms tak wale alkanes colourless (be-rang), odourless (be-boo) gases hain, jabke pentane se heptadecane (C₅ se C₁₇) tak colourless, odourless liquids hain. C₁₈ aur us se aage wale bare members mom jaise (waxy) solids hain, yeh bhi colourless aur odourless hain.
Alkanes non-polar ya bohat kam polar hain. Is liye yeh pani jaise polar solvents mein nahi hal hote, magar hexane, benzene, ether jaise non-polar solvents mein hal ho jate hain.

In ke physical constants, maslan boiling point, melting point aur density, carbon atoms barhne ke saath barhte hain, jabke solubility (hal hone ki salahiyat) molecular mass barhne ke saath kam hoti hai. Branched chain wale alkanes ka boiling point apne isomer (wahi formula) seedhi chain wale alkane se kam hota hai. Maslan seedhi chain wali butane ka boiling point −0.50 °C hai, jo 2-methylpropane (isobutane, −11.7 °C) se zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Branched alkanes ke boiling points seedhi chain wale alkanes se kam kyun hote hain (Quick Check 11.2a)?
blocks.explanation: Alkane molecules sirf kamzor intermolecular forces (molecules ke darmiyan kashish) se jure hote hain, aur yeh is par depend karti hain ke molecules aik doosre ko kitni surface (satah) se chhoo sakte hain. Seedhi chain apni poori lambai mein saath wale molecules se lag sakti hai. Branched isomer zyada gol aur chhota (compact) hota hai, kam surface chhoota hai, is liye forces kamzor hoti hain aur use ubalne ke liye kam energy chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Explain karein ke alkanes ki shape tetrahedral kyun hoti hai, aur cyclopropane aur cyclopentane ki shapes banayein (Quick Check 11.2b, c).
blocks.explanation: Alkane ka har carbon sp³ hybridized hai: us ke gird bonding electrons ke chaar pairs hain aur koi lone pair nahi. Yeh chaar pairs aik doosre ko barabar dhakel kar jitna ho sake door, 109.5° par, chale jate hain; yahi tetrahedral shape hai. Cyclopropane teen CH₂ groups ka triangular (teen kono wala) ring (halqa) hai aur cyclopentane paanch CH₂ groups ka pentagonal (paanch kono wala) ring.

answer_figure.alt: Teen hisson ka jawab diagram: (a) methane ka tetrahedral carbon, chaar H atoms, aik wedge aur aik dashed bond, H-C-H angle 109.5 degree; (b) cyclopropane C3H6, teen CH2 groups ka triangular ring, angle 60 degree; (c) cyclopentane C5H10, paanch CH2 groups ka pentagonal ring, angle taqreeban 108 degree.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: alkane carbon ki tetrahedral shape, cyclopropane (C₃H₆) ka triangular ring aur cyclopentane (C₅H₁₀) ka pentagonal ring. (Kitab ki Table 11.5 mein cyclopentane ka formula C₄H₁₀ chhapa hai; sahi C₅H₁₀ hai.)
answer_figure.long_description: Pehle hisse mein alkane ka aik carbon hai jis ke chaar bonds chaar H atoms tak jate hain: do kaghaz ki surface (plane) mein, aik moti wedge (dekhne wale ki taraf) aur aik dashed line (peechhe ki taraf). Do bonds ke darmiyan 109.5° ka angle nishan laga hai. Doosre hisse mein cyclopropane hai: teen CH₂ groups tikon (triangle) ke konon par, har C–C–C angle 60°. Teesre hisse mein cyclopentane hai: paanch CH₂ groups panj-kone (pentagon) ke konon par, angle taqreeban 108°.

items: C₁–C₄ gases, C₅–C₁₇ liquids, C₁₈+ waxy solids; non-polar, pani mein hal nahi hote; boiling point, melting point aur density carbon ke saath barhte hain; branching boiling point kam karti hai (butane −0.5 °C, isobutane −11.7 °C).
